item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image, with no border or frame. Build the composition from a deep, near-black indigo ground interrupted by dense, restless bands of electric cyan, hot coral, pale cream, and sharp acid yellow. Let broad, rough brushstrokes collide with fine scratches, translucent washes, scraped-back layers, and small bursts of stippled pigment. Gather the most intense color and texture into an off-center knot, then pull loose gestures outward until they thin into quiet, dark space. Balance compression and release, abrupt contrast and soft bleed, repetition and interruption; make the surface feel layered, searching, and alive with uncertain rhythm. Keep it entirely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, gallery, or surrounding setting."}
